verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a Cloud API for triggering/managing payments on Solo/Go terminal readers via HTTPS requests, with sandbox testing, virtual reader pairing, and multiple payment flows, plus SDKs and API key auth for building custom backend-driven POS checkouts; a community developer confirms building a custom integration directly against the public API. missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec found (probe returned 404s) and no independent large-scale case study beyond one HN mention.
